<color:0xffacdae8>There is a circular indentation\ncarved into the face of the stone\nmonument.
S-Sir Adol?!
Um, by any chance, were you listening\nto the flute melody just now?
How embarrassing...
It is something I learned from \nmy mother, but I can never seem\nto play it right...
I come here every so often\nto practice.
There are many dangerous beasts here, \nbut the view is just so magnificent...
What you see in front of you is the\nisland of ruins, the Zemeth Sanctum.
Beyond that, you can see the\nrocky peaks of Grana-Vallis.
Though the area beyond the shore is \nclosed off by the Vortex, the harbor \nalways enjoys good weather.
It must be Alma's doing...\nShe must be protecting the Sanctum...
I intend to stay here for a while,\nso I can practice my flute.
Sir Adol, please be careful.
<color:0xffacdae8>Adol offers a mirror fragment\nto Olha.
What?
Could that be...?
It is broken, but there is no doubt...\nIt is my mother's mirror...
Oh...
I-I am sorry...\nI am just... so happy...
I thought I would never get it back...
Thank you...\nTruly, thank you so much...
I am sorry that you had to see me \nlike that...
This mirror has been passed down from\npriestess to priestess. We believe\nthat the mirror houses Alma's soul.
For me, it is also a memento of\nthe previous priestess...\nmy late mother.
Really... I am so glad that\nit came back to me...
